content: Llaquishca quiric huauqui Gayo, Quiriccunata cuirac rucu runa ashami ñuca canma quillcauni. Diosmanda sirtu shimita cambas uyashcamandami canda llaquisha quillcauni.
Can Yaya Dioshuan alita causashcacuinta, tucui camba causaibis ali tucuchun, camba aichahuas ama ungurichun nisha canmanda Diosta mañasha tapuuni llaquishca huauqui.
Shuc quiric huauquiguna cambagmanda ñucama shamusha cuintahuanaura can Diospa sirtu shimita alita catiushcamanda. Chita uyasha yapa cushiyarani.
Diospacpi ñuca churi tucuccuinta accuna Diospa sirtu shimita catisha causashcata uyashami yapa ashca cushiyani.
Llaquishca huauqui, alita rashcangui Jesucristomanda camachisha puriuc runagunata yanapasha, chasnallata mana ricsishca quiric huauquigunatahuas.

Chi shamuc runaguna tucui ñucanchi quiric muntun ñaupacpi can yapa llaquisha yanapashcata cuintanaura. Paiguna cutillata cambagma shamunaupi can Diosta cushiyachishcacuinta tucui paiguna minishtishcatas cusha cachangui.
Paiguna Señor Jesucristo munashcata rashami purinaun. Chiraicumi mana Jesusta quiric runagunamandaga imatahuas mana tapunaun.
Chasna acpimi ñucanchiga paigunata yanapana anchi, paigunahuan pariu chi sirtu shimita mas ashcayachingahua nisha.
Quiriccunama ña quillcashcani randi chi Diótrefes nishca runaga pai munaitucusha nishami ñucanchi rimashca shimita uyanata mana munanzhu.

Chiraicumi ñuca chibi pactamushaga Diótrefes mana ali rashcagunata paglla pambai rimangaraunimi. Paiga llullashami ñucanchimanda mana alita rimaun, chasnallata chi Jesucristomanda camachisha puriu runagunatas mana yanapanata munanzhu, chasnallata yanapasha nic runagunatas jarcanmi chasnallata paigunata quiric muntunmandas llucshichisha cachanmi.
Llaquishca huauqui canga ima chi runashina ranguichu. Alita rac runaga Diospa runami, randi mana alita rac runaga Dios ali acta mana yachanzhu. Chasna acpi alita rasha canga causangui.

Demetrio nishca runa yapa ali acta yachashami tucui runaguna alitami raun nisha rimanaun, Diospa ali ranata pactachishami paiga causaun. Ñáucanchihuas pai ali causaushcata yachashami paimanda alita rimaunchi, ñucanchi rimashcaga sirtu ashcata ña yachanguichimi.
Cai shimillata canda quillcauni, ashcata canda rimanata munarani chasnagllaita cai cartaibiga mana tucuita quillcanichu.

Chasna acpi astahuanbas ñuca munani canhuan uctalla tupanacusha ñahuipura tucuita cuintanacungahua. Cunan Diospa cushi causanaga cambacpi tiyachun. Caibi tiyac quiric huauquiguna canda saludaunguna. Chibi tiyac quiric huauquigunatas caran shucta saludapangui. Chillata quillcauni, Juan.
